limits: Timeline collection deltas are exact kg totals over sampled endpoint windows; rates are kg/round, not action counts.
Trip collects is kg over all wells/resources in that trip. Stored well and type identify the dominant well/type only.
Trip cohort amounts do not identify exact kg at that coordinate/type. Spanning trips prevent within-window action timing.
A dominant well is confirmed used by last_collect, not necessarily at first_collect. Current upgrades require round well fields/action amounts.

upgrade_reference.limits: Ideal six continuously collecting residents, no travel/crowding/aura and no changes to worker count. Initial HQ stock can fund deposits; worker-turn capacity alone cannot rule out early upgrades.
